entries.613338a45290ee85: Its feature is that it owns the in-house developed cloud PBX 'Omnia LINK.' The Business Description states that cases in which contact center and BPO service providers own in-house developed PBXs are extremely rare, and explains that Omnia LINK provides everything from basic functions to real-time text conversion of call audio and FAQ recommendations in an all-in-one package. As it is cloud-based, it can be used without restrictions on locations or home-working environments.
